license.title: Licence
license.description:
**Server ID:** `{server_id}`

**Automatic activation** - leave the licence server address below as it is and submit. If a licence has already been issued for this Server ID, the key is installed straight away and keeps itself up to date.

**No internet at this site, or no licence issued yet?** Go to [{portal_host}]({portal_url}), enter the Server ID above, and paste the key you receive into the box below.

Leave both untouched to run the {trial_days}-day demo - everything works normally, and after that entities stay unavailable until a key is installed from this integration's Configure menu.

license_contact.title: Your details
license_contact.description:
So we know who this licence is for and can let you know when it's been activated, please give us a name and an email address.

These are sent to the licence server with your Server ID `{server_id}` and are only used to contact you about this licence.

manual.title: Gateway details
manual.description: Enter or confirm the IP address and port of your HDL Buspro gateway (default port 6000). The local IP is optional and only needed to bind the receive socket to a specific interface.

gateway.title: Gateway settings
gateway.description: Change connection settings for the HDL Buspro gateway.

scan_bus.title: Scan bus for devices
scan_bus.description: Listen on the HDL bus and discover devices automatically. A few read requests are broadcast to make quiet devices respond. Pick how long to listen, then choose what to import on the next screen.

scan_results.title: Discovered devices
scan_results.description: Found {found} device(s) on the bus ({new} new). Tick the ones to import. The label shows the inferred type, raw HDL type code and channel count. With “split channels” on, a multi-channel device is imported as one entity per channel; turn it off to import a single entity you can configure by hand. Everything gets sensible defaults you can refine via Edit a device. If a dimmer module was imported as a switch, find its raw type code in the label (or the scan log) and add it to the dimmer type codes box - those codes are remembered and always import as dimmable lights.

license_trial.title: AR HDL BUSPRO is running in demo mode
license_trial.description:
This install has {days_left} day(s) of the demo left. When it runs out all AR HDL BUSPRO entities become unavailable until a licence key is entered.

Server ID: `{server_id}`

Request a key at activatelicense.arsmarthome.co.za, then enter it under Settings > Devices & Services > AR HDL BUSPRO > Configure > Licence.

license_inactive.title: AR HDL BUSPRO is not licensed
license_inactive.description:
The demo period has ended or the stored licence key is no longer valid, so all AR HDL BUSPRO entities are unavailable. Your devices and settings are untouched and come straight back once a key is entered.

Server ID: `{server_id}`

Request a key at activatelicense.arsmarthome.co.za, then enter it under Settings > Devices & Services > AR HDL BUSPRO > Configure > Licence.
